findings.description: Gust Johs Huhtala had a son Jöran, born 3 February 1820 and christened 7 February 1820 at Kauhava, Vaasa, Finland.
supporting_sources: Finland, Baptisms, 1657-1890 — entry for Joran, 1820, parents Gust Johs Huhtala and Lisa Jordr

findings.description: The mother named on the 1820 Jöran baptism is Lisa Jöransdotter, not the Kaisa Johansdotter the tree records as Gust Johs Huhtala's wife.

person.name: Lisa Jordr (Elisabet Jöransdotter)
person.role: named as mother on the 7 February 1820 Kauhava baptism
